description: This file contains functions and types for handling plugin installation requests and policies, including resolving plugin sources, reading recovery metadata, and determining policies based on plugin configurations.

methods.name: isPluginInstallCommand
methods.description: Checks if the command path corresponds to a plugin install command.

methods.name: readBundledInstallRecoveryMetadata
methods.description: Reads recovery metadata from a plugin's package.json to determine if invalid config recovery is allowed.

methods.name: resolveBundledInstallRecoveryMetadata
methods.description: Resolves recovery metadata for a plugin, possibly using bundled source lookup.

methods.name: resolvePluginInstallArgvTokens
methods.description: Extracts plugin-related tokens from command-line arguments based on command path.

methods.name: resolvePluginInstallArgvRequest
methods.description: Resolves plugin install request parameters from command-line arguments.

methods.name: resolvePluginInstallRequestContext
methods.description: Creates a plugin install request context, resolving paths and recovery metadata.

methods.name: resolvePluginInstallPreactionRequest
methods.description: Resolves plugin install request context from command action parameters.

methods.name: resolvePluginInstallInvalidConfigPolicy
methods.description: Determines the invalid config policy based on plugin request context.
